# The Poteto Frontier

> A playful, self-reported chart of trust in AI agents, inspired by Lauren Tan (@poteto) and named as a pun on the Pareto frontier.

Users place themselves on a curve according to how many AI agents they generally have working on their behalf at any given time. They can optionally add their public X profile photo and download the chart as a PNG. This is a meme, not a measured score or a scientific model. No account or sign-in is required.

Created by Travis Fischer (@transitive_bs).

## Links

- [Site](https://poteto-frontier.vercel.app/): Interactive chart
- [Source](https://github.com/transitive-bullshit/poteto-frontier): MIT-licensed React app
- [Inspiration](https://x.com/poteto): Lauren Tan
